meta.description: Sangu Humanitarian Foundation is a voluntary, non-political, non-communal and non-profit humanitarian organisation standing beside the helpless, the poor and the underprivileged.

brand.name: Sangu Humanitarian Foundation
brand.motto: Unity is our strength, humanity is our identity.
brand.tagline: From the banks of the Sangu to the path of humanity, moving forward together.

hero.eyebrow: Rooted in Sangu, United for Humanity
hero.subtitle: A voluntary humanitarian organisation built on the friendship, love and unity of friends who grew up on the banks of the Sangu river. Our purpose is to stand beside the helpless, the poor and people in distress.

about.title: From friendship to the service of humanity
story: Sangu Humanitarian Foundation is a voluntary, humanitarian and social welfare organisation. It began with the friendship, love, unity and mutual support of friends who grew up on the banks of the Sangu river.
The organisation was founded to stand beside the helpless, the poor, the underprivileged and people in distress.
about.area: Our work starts in the areas along the Sangu river and its surroundings. With the consent of members and as our capacity grows, we will widen our reach.

nature.title: Non-profit
nature.text: Not a business or profit-making institution.

nature.title: Non-political & non-communal
nature.text: All our activities are non-political and non-communal.

nature.title: Protected resources
nature.text: Funds and assets are never used for personal gain.

about.notice: The organisation currently operates informally. Legal registration will be pursued in the future as needed.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To build a humane, cooperative, equitable and beautiful society where every person has the chance to receive dignity, compassion and the support they need.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To stand beside helpless and underprivileged people through the combined capacity, time, labour and financial support of friends, members and well-wishers, and to run regular humanitarian and social welfare activities.

programs.title: How we stand beside people
programs.subtitle: Programs are taken up based on the organisation's capacity, available funds and community needs.

points: Providing tin sheets, wood and building materials

items.title: Marriage & family support

items.title: Medical support
points: Helping with treatment costs for poor patients
Standing by accident and critical-illness victims

items.title: Ramadan & food support
points: Food supplies for families in need

items.title: Education support
points: Books, notebooks and learning materials for poor students
Scholarships for talented students in need

items.title: Disaster relief
points: Relief during floods and natural disasters
Supplying clean water, food and essentials

items.title: Social initiatives
points: Support for orphans, the elderly and people with disabilities

objectives.title: Our 12 committed objectives
items: Supporting the livelihoods of helpless and poor people.
Creating educational opportunities for poor and talented students.
Helping sick and helpless patients get treatment.
Helping poor families build and repair their homes.
Supporting low-income families with weddings and family needs.
Providing iftar, food and other aid during Ramadan.
Standing beside people affected by floods, cyclones and natural disasters.
Distributing winter clothes, clothing and food.
Running blood donation and health awareness activities.
Working for orphans, the elderly, people with disabilities and the underprivileged.
Promoting tree planting, environmental protection and social awareness.
Taking other humanitarian and public-welfare initiatives as society needs.

principles.title: The values that guide us

items.title: Humanity
items.text: Human welfare is our main purpose.

items.title: Honesty
items.text: Upholding ethics and truthfulness in everything we do.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: Keeping income and expenses clear to everyone.

items.title: Unity
items.text: Working through mutual respect and cooperation.

items.title: Equality
items.text: Helping regardless of religion, race, gender, profession or wealth.

items.title: Accountability
items.text: Taking responsibility for every decision and activity.

items.title: Selfless service
items.text: Putting people's welfare before personal gain.

principles.commitment: Each of us will stand beside people according to our own ability. No one's dignity or rights in the organisation depend on how much they contribute.

donate.title: Your small help can be someone's biggest hope
donate.quote: Everyone contributes as much as they are able.
policy: No fixed monthly or yearly contribution is required.
Everyone can give voluntarily, according to their means.
The size of a contribution never decides anyone's standing or say.
donate.nonMonetary: Even if you cannot give money, you can contribute your time, labour, skills and advice. We value every contribution, big or small.
donate.receiptNote: The date, amount and source of every donation is recorded, and financial reports are published regularly.

involved.title: Join us on this journey of humanity
involved.subtitle: For now the organisation is run by its founding friends. Membership will later open to interested and suitable people, so register your interest today.

types.title: Founding member
types.text: Those who took the initiative to found the organisation and run its first activities.

types.title: General member
types.text: Interested and suitable people who join the organisation in the future.

types.title: Associate member
types.text: Those who help with money, time, labour, skills or advice.

types.title: Well-wisher
types.text: Those who support our purpose and help with various initiatives.

transparency.title: Every taka accounted for, every action owned
transparency.subtitle: Under our constitution, transparency and accountability are the foundation of all our work.

items.title: Every donation recorded
items.text: The date, amount and source of each donation is documented.

items.title: Proof of every expense
items.text: A receipt or proof is kept for every expense.

items.title: Project-wise accounts
items.text: Income and expenses are kept and published separately for each project.

items.title: Regular reports
items.text: Periodic financial reports, plus an overall report at least once a year.

items.title: Collective decisions
items.text: No single person makes major financial or organisational decisions.

items.title: Dignity & privacy
items.text: The personal information, dignity and privacy of aid recipients are protected.

committee.title: The people entrusted with our work
committee.subtitle: In the first phase, the committee is being formed from the founding members.

roles.title: President
roles.duty: Overall leadership and oversight of key activities.

roles.title: Vice President
roles.duty: Assists the President and acts on their behalf when needed.

roles.title: General Secretary
roles.duty: Runs organisational activities and implements decisions.

roles.title: Joint General Secretary
roles.duty: Assists the General Secretary in running activities.

roles.title: Treasurer
roles.duty: Keeps the accounts and presents financial reports.

roles.title: Organising Secretary
roles.duty: Keeps in touch with members and supports organisational work.

roles.title: Publicity & Communication Secretary
roles.duty: Activity reports, communication and record keeping.

roles.title: Executive Members
roles.duty: Plan and carry out humanitarian activities.

lines: We will never judge anyone by their means. We will honour every contribution, big or small.
We will stand by people in their sorrow and reach out a helping hand in hard times.
Our greatest identity: we are human, and we want to stand by one another.
pledge.closing: Unity is our strength, humanity is our identity.
